name: weatherwise
description: WeatherWise: Real-Time Weather Monitoring and Forecasting Web Application

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('client/package.json')){ try{ const {execSync}=require('child_process'); execSync('cd client && npm install && npm run build', {stdio:'inherit'}); }catch(e){ console.log('Client build notice:', e.message); } }"
scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('client/package.json')){ try{ const {execSync}=require('child_process'); execSync('cd client && npm install', {stdio:'inherit'}); }catch(e){ console.log('Postinstall notice:', e.message); } }"
